name: daydock
description: A calm, local-first workday planner for capture, priorities, focus, follow-ups, and daily review.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/finalize-service-worker.mjs
scripts.build:pages: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode pages && node scripts/finalize-service-worker.mjs && node scripts/verify-pages-build.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.check: npm run verify && npm run build
